description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Developments - Amendment to the Gaz. Extra Ordinary No. 2129/94  of the 28.06.2019, published on  Colombo Urban Development Areas
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns the rectification of a previous legal notice regarding urban development plans. It involves amendments to statutory instruments under the Urban Development Authority Law, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on correcting legal wording and procedural details in a previously published gazette, which falls under regulatory framework modifications.
